method.paths: Production Vite builds; real createTableProvider TypeScript and Rust Web Workers. Common client validation, clone, worker transport, Rust wire conversions, Wasm startup and response publication included.
method.cache: Fresh worker each observation; browser HTTP cache warmed by parity and 3 warmups. Not cold network.
method.order: Sequential alternating engine order per paired iteration; no concurrent executor workloads. Driver transfers the exact tagged wire as one JSON string, parsed before the timed harness begins; pre-transfer JSON roundtrip is independently checked. This avoids driver serialization overhead, not executor work.
method.boundaries: Factory, acquire including startup, initial apply, sequential first 100-row block then totals, total cold-load-ready; restore initial definition outside each warm pivot or sort/filter edit; edit apply and block/totals-ready; full pulled export from restored initial definition.
method.parity: Preflight only, outside observations (not parity for every timed trial): each action and full export against independent calculateView baseline and cross-engine view/block/export metadata. Only requestId and transferId transport identifiers excluded. Exact structural keys, row IDs/order, values/errors/formats, columns, totals and export metadata; 1e-12 relative/absolute numeric tolerance for explicit output column IDs whose published aggregation is mean or whose aggregate formula AST is division, at row/totals values locations only; source fields, metadata, errors, formats and signed zero remain exact. Historical gate limitation: its trailing-key location test could permit differences in specially nested metadata/raw cell objects. Those shapes are not present in these workloads. All 14 accepted nonmixed cases subsequently passed stricter anchored, action-specific schema parity; see matched-executors-revalidation.json. This is preflight revalidation, not per-trial parity.
method.statistics: Median (average central pair), nearest-rank p95; individual observations in chronological engine order. Warmups discarded.
method.uiPaint: Not measured: no shared renderer harness. Separate future UI/device acceptance gate.
method.memory: Not measured: browser worker allocator/process peaks unavailable; 20k representative desktop workload is not an iPad limit.
method.activation: TypeScript remains default; desktop evidence only; regular iPad/device acceptance outstanding.
method.knownMixedInstability: Scaled mixed1000 is blocked from timings even if current preflight passes; original mixed12 remains separately measured when preflight passes. Diagnostic evidence: mixed-parity-diagnostic.json.

postCollectionCorrections.originalParityMethod: Preflight only, outside observations (not parity for every timed trial): each action and full export against independent calculateView baseline and cross-engine view/block/export metadata. Only requestId and transferId transport identifiers excluded. Exact structural keys, row IDs/order, values/errors/formats, columns, totals and export metadata; 1e-12 relative/absolute numeric tolerance for explicit output column IDs whose published aggregation is mean or whose aggregate formula AST is division, at row/totals values locations only; source fields, metadata, errors, formats and signed zero remain exact.
postCollectionCorrections.reason: Independent review found future-run timeout continuation, unowned fixed-port readiness and a nested-shape numeric tolerance hole. No timeout or server collision was observed in the saved collection; affected nested shapes are absent from its workloads. All accepted nonmixed cases passed corrected parity. Recorded observations/statistics were not changed.
fixes: Coded deadlines/fatal child exits close the browser context before abandoning every remaining case on that page. Aborted/incomplete collections are partial with nonzero exit and explicit unmeasured browser/case entries.

Random owner-token health header must match the spawned live child; liveness is checked after readiness, before page load and each observation. Existing healthy unrelated server and EADDRINUSE are rejected.

Numeric tolerance is anchored only to baseline row/totals roots or exact action-specific snapshot exported/block row/totals roots, with a separate output-ID set for each snapshot. Nested metadata/raw objects remain exact.
Working-tree provenance is computed from Git status.
postCollectionCorrections.revalidationVersusCurrent: The archived revalidation driver/helper differ from current files only in final aborted/completeness status handling, which was regression tested; parity helpers, harness, workloads and owned server are unchanged.
